UPDATE workspaces SET
                archived = COALESCE($1, archived),
                pinned = COALESCE($2, pinned),
                name = CASE WHEN $3 THEN $4 ELSE name END,
                venture = CASE WHEN $5 THEN $6 ELSE venture END,
                updated_at = datetime('now', 'subsec')
            WHERE id = $7
